title: Sail to Klein Curacao for its lighthouse, beach and reef
description: Cross by catamaran to the small offshore island, walk to its old lighthouse, then swim or snorkel from the beach.

title: Enter Roskilde Cathedral and see Denmark's royal tombs
description: Step inside the cathedral to follow centuries of Danish royal burials through its chapels and architecture.

title: Tour Frederiksborg Castle's royal halls and gardens
description: Walk the royal rooms of Frederiksborg, now home to the Museum of National History, and leave time for its formal gardens.

title: Swim at Kolokytha Bay on a Spinalonga boat day
description: Take a boat from the Elounda area and swim in the clear water at Kolokytha Bay during a wider Spinalonga outing.

title: Watch molten lava pour at Reykjavik's Lava Show
description: Watch a controlled indoor demonstration of real molten lava and learn how Icelandic eruptions shape the island.

title: Swim inside the Blue Cave on a Kotor speedboat trip
description: Ride across the Bay of Kotor by speedboat and, when conditions allow, swim in the blue-lit sea cave near the Luštica Peninsula.

title: Ride a bamboo bicycle through Intramuros
description: Pedal a locally made bamboo bicycle through Manila’s walled district with a guide who explains its streets and history.

title: Visit Sinaia Monastery beneath the Carpathians
description: Visit the monastery that gave Sinaia its name and explore the church and courtyard beneath the Carpathian slopes.

title: Cycle through Bang Krachao's green lanes
description: Cross the river from Bangkok and cycle quiet paths through Bang Krachao’s gardens, canals and neighbourhoods.

title: Watch hummingbirds from Asa Wright's rainforest verandah
description: Sit at the rainforest centre’s verandah to watch hummingbirds at close range, then join a guided walk if available.

title: Cycle through Ninh Binh's limestone fields to Bich Dong
description: Ride rural lanes past rice fields and limestone peaks toward Bich Dong, stopping to explore the pagoda area.

title: Watch a water-puppet performance at Hanoi's Thang Long Theatre
description: See Vietnamese folk stories told through puppets moving across a water stage with live traditional music.
